title: Raft Tuah
description: Ever felt like sailing the seven seas on a Create: Aeronautics raft? This is the pack for you!!
body:
![The raft you start on](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0b680e677bf244db357e01437f04c5d7c09e888_0.webp)

_Can you beat the game starting off of a physics-enabled raft and nothing but a fishing rod?_
# Test your skills in Raft Tuah!!

### _(Recently updated with localization in 8 languages!)_
Arabic, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
  
![Portable raft being translated to Japanese](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80ef033f0e221d86a62ea3c7b3092e20321cce8a.png)

To get started, just create a singleplayer world. You can now choose which raft you'd like to start with! 
Currently, there's 5 options, which should definitely spice up your playthrough!!

![Raft selection screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3954aa86e07bc9c5c900ca75bca82b84f529d59b.jpeg)

The fishing loot table is adjusted so you can get create mod resources to build off of!

There's custom drops and custom blocks that should help you on your expedition, like supply drops, supply crates, and even Bobby Fishers (which you can craft to aid you in fishing!)

The ender dragon bossfight has been visually (and auditively) overhauled to fit the pirate theme. Good luck!

## And if you're ever stuck...
### Check out the advancements tab for some hints towards progression! 
You'll have built a fully functional, hypermobile raft in no time!
![Advancements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e578549fb5d05841bf1b1037ff25f50b5c6766c_0.webp)

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
**"CAN YOU GET THESE SUPPLY DROPS TO STOP POLLUTING THE BLUE SEAS???"**

Supply drops seem too frequent to you? You can disable them entirely with 
```
/gamerule supplydropfrequency 0
```

**"I CANT PLACE BLOCKS OUTSIDE MY RAFT!"**

That's kinda the point of the challenge. Though, there's a gamerule to disable that if it really upsets you (i wouldn't recommend enabling it as it defeats the purpose of this whole modpack)
```
/gamerule canPlaceBlocksOutsideRaft true
```

**"I got to the nether and got softlocked!"**

There's a rare bug where entering the nether for the first time doesn't correctly spawn a raft next to you. If that happens, you can use
```
/spawnraft @s
```
to correct that, OR look for an item called the "Dispensable Raft", which is rarely found in ruined portal chests. It allows you to dispense a lava-proof raft anywhere you want!

**"Why is it called Raft Tuah"**

I am terribly uncreative (and also calling it Mineraft would've been hell for SEO)

**Sail on and enjoy!**
